titles.title: Beauford Delaney

description: Depicts Beauford Delaney, an American modernist painter. In this composition he looks out at the viewer with a slight smile. The artist's head, neck, and shoulders are drawn in color and contrast with the plain gray of the paper surrounding it. Delaney wears a gray jacket and a white shirt with a high collar.
title: Beauford Delaney
